# Adversarial pass: replay of the REF-01037 digest (second run)

Read-only throughout. Canonical `data/guidebook.db` sha256 is `3c575c89c1a6af4b9d2192e9eb43ed78bfeb366d7b31fe5fe41715c731634cdb` at start and end, equal to the executor's recorded value. My scratch folder `.../scratchpad/crit-edm2` was created empty and removed by exact path. Every count below was computed in this run.

Paths used:
- Replay DB (`R`): `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-guidebook/5dbc61f3-e21d-5874-a6a8-3a991f0f402c/scratchpad/replay/guidebook.db`
- Session folder (`S`): `/home/user/guidebook/scratchpad/session_2026-11-13-edmonton-checklist-pass/`
- Retrieval log (`L`): `/home/user/guidebook/retrieval-log/session_2026-11-13-edmonton-checklist-pass/`

## Findings, worst first

### F1. HIGH. The `exceeds` edge states the reverse of the source (L2)
- **Artefact:** `extraction_relations` relation_id 64 in `R` and `S/batch.sql`; three parked edges in `S/parked-writes.jsonl` (keys `6.1-1in16`, `2.10-1800`).
- **Claim:** "an `exceeds` edge from 920 to 850 is the source's own pairing."
- **Failure:** the table's DDL defines `exceeds` as "the source asserts the referent's value is more than needed". Row 64 is `from 229 (920) exceeds to 228 (850)`, `stated='named'`. As typed, it says the source finds 850 mm more than needed.
- **Against the render:** p0002 item 2.3 prints 850 in blue (Code) and "(920mm/36” preferred)" in magenta. p0000 says "there is a need to exceed minimum standards". The source says 850 is not enough.
- **Why it happened:** the executor matched the English word, not the vocabulary's meaning. `db.py` refuses `insufficient` from a `figure_role='claim'` row (`grep -n 'cannot carry a' scripts/db.py`), so the only word-alike left was the inverse.
- **Parked edges repeat it:** 1:16 `exceeds` 1:12, and 1800 `exceeds` 1100. Run as written, each writes the same inversion.
- **Gate:** `extraction_relations_integrity` reported CLEAN over 60 edges. It checks shape, not meaning, and could not have gone red on this.
- **Command:** `select sql from sqlite_master where name='extraction_relations'`, then `select * from extraction_relations where relation_id=64` on `R`.

### F2. HIGH. R16 is green because its subject was routed into the one outcome it does not read; DEFERRED again covers two states (L6)
- **Artefact:** `term_adjudications` for observations 99 to 201 in `R`; `S/checks-after-engine-v2.txt` line 21; `scripts/audit/research_batch_dod.py` (R16).
- **Claim:** "NAMES-EXISTING only to parameters or declined terms, everything else DEFERRED with a rationale naming the open owner question"; R16 PASS.
- **Failure, part 1:** R16's rule is "every concept a source states a figure for is disposed of". It examined 7 terms. 90 of 103 adjudications carry `term_id NULL`, which R16 reports and does not assert on.
- **Failure, part 2:** 12 DEFERRED rationales themselves name the held term the phrase names and say it is "not adjudicated to it here" because that "would fail R16":

  | Observation | Held term named in its own rationale |
  |---|---|
  | 99 | TERM-017 |
  | 102 | TERM-079 |
  | 103 | TERM-027 |
  | 114, 133 | TERM-028 |
  | 121 | TERM-004 |
  | 130 | TERM-019 |
  | 137 | TERM-010 |
  | 147 | TERM-014 |
  | 183 | TERM-008 |
  | 189 | TERM-025 |
  | 196 | TERM-006 |

- **Failure, part 3:** the schema defines DEFERRED as "cannot be settled on this source alone". These 12 are settled, by the rationale's own words. A further 28 "a quantity the source states a figure for" rows are the kind ADJUDICATION Q2 item 2 ruled is settled on this source (its example is handrail height).
- **Rationales cite a question for something it does not say:** AQ-7 asks about bulk declination. It is cited as the reason a NAMES-EXISTING adjudication is not recorded.
- **Brief breached:** REPLAY-BRIEF step 3 says "If this conflicts with R16 or any DoD rule, report the conflict; do not work around it." The report line F16 reports the conflict and the rows work around it.
- **Command:** `select observation_id, rationale from term_adjudications where observation_id>=99 and outcome='DEFERRED' and rationale like '%which is neither a parameter nor declined%'` on `R` returns 12.

### F3. MEDIUM. The item 4.5 harm statement is in no observation, though two rows say it is; the gap carries an invented gloss; other hazards are omitted (S1)
- **Artefact:** GAP-108 and `search_executions` 204 `findings_note` in `R` and `batch.sql`; `observed_terms` 142.
- **Claim:** the three hazards (1.5, 4.5, 8.2) are "each held as an observation".
- **Failure:** observation 142's quote is only "Ensure any open area beneath the stairs is enclosed with planters, railings, benches, fencing etc to ensure no access." The sentence "Tactile strips under the stairs … to alert a potential safety hazard" (p0003, magenta in the text layer) is in no `context_quote` of REF-01037. Items 1.5 (obs 109) and 8.2 (obs 174) do carry their harm words.
- **Invented gloss:** GAP-108 adds "(… a head-strike and cane-detection hazard)". The source says only "a potential safety hazard".
- **Omitted statements of the same kind:**
  - 6.5 "(able to open doors without backing onto ramp)"
  - 8.5 "insulate any exposed pipes"
  - 11.2 "grey colours should be avoided as they blend into the general background"
  - 4.3 "Avoid single isolated steps"
  - 8.6 "toilet paper reachable without leaning too far off toilet"
- **Gate:** R7's PASS line says "whether harm … reached a row is adversarial standing subject 1". It asserted nothing here.
- **Method:** per-item diff of the text layer against the union of observation quotes.

### F4. MEDIUM. Item 2.4 is parked as naming "no person, function or need" when it names a function; the warrant rule was applied two ways (L5)
- **Artefact:** `S/parked-writes.jsonl` key `2.4-absent-force`; extraction 232 lens link 221.
- **Failure:** p0002 item 2.4 (blue) reads "Door operating device should not require tight grasping or twisting of the wrist". That names a hand function. `access_needs` A-PRECISION's design obligation reads "no fine-motor…". The parked `lens_note` says the clause "names no person, function or need" and waits on AQ-1.
- **Inconsistency:** the same run accepted "resting areas" (a feature name) as naming the need A-EFFORT.
- **Effect:** the report's access-need table shows A-PRECISION at zero on every parameter. The dexterity content is dropped from the lens record by a false statement about the clause.

### F5. MEDIUM. Six of seven lens links are identity-only on the parent MOB; the larger half of first-run F4 is repeated (L5)
- **Artefact:** `extraction_lens_links` 217 to 223 in `R`.
- **Claim:** "F4 done."
- **Failure:** ADJUDICATION Q6 item 4 and section 4 name "wrote no ICF or access-need link" as the larger half of F4. Six links are `identity_code='MOB'` with no ICF and no need. The report's own "lens by figure" count lists REF-01037: 4 value figures whose only link is a parent identity (228 to 231).
- **Registry evidence:** `access_needs` A-REACH's design obligation names "doorway/turning clearance" and absorbs "wheelchair users". No such link was written.
- **Command:** `select extraction_id, identity_code, needs_code, icf_code from v_live_lens_links where extraction_id between 228 and 234` on `R`.

### F6. MEDIUM. The report's explanation of the pending cells is false for one cell and misdescribes two; the engine's gap sentences ship untrue (L2)
- **Artefact:** `S/DIGEST-REPORT.md` verdict and section 5; `S/cell-12-A-EFFORT.json`; GAP-115, 116, 117 in `batch.sql`.
- **Cell 12 × A-EFFORT:** the report says "no in-lens source can anchor". By count the lens holds two sources. One is REF-01033, tier 1 clinical, `high_control`. Its finding (extraction 167) is `extraction_method='skim'` and is left out (`skimmed_findings: [167]`). REF-01037 reads `population_directness: NOT_ASSESSED` (`needs_population_assessment: ["REF-01037"]`) because the only population match written targets MOB. The report states neither.
- **Cells 5 and 9 × MOB:** the report says "A MOB cell built on codes". Each lens holds 5 distinct sources, two of them grey tier 3 (REF-00468, REF-01037). `regulatory_stratum_only=1` and `code_floor_only=1` are written because the engine's regulatory branch fires whenever no anchor exists, not because the cell is codes only.
- **Gap text:** GAP-115 to 117 say the sources were "disqualified, or tier not derivable". REF-01037's record reads `tier_consistent: true`, `conditioning: DOWN-WEIGHTED`.
- **What held:** the in-lens table in section 5 (5 / 5 / 2 distinct sources, 8 / 8 / 2 extractions) matches my recount.

### F7. MEDIUM. Concepts the page names are in no observation, and the report never says which groups the document reaches (L7)
- **Artefact:** `observed_terms` for REF-01037; `S/DIGEST-REPORT.md` section 6.
- **Claim:** "one pass of observations covering all 75 items and every printed figure."
- **What held:** all 75 items have an observation, every printed number is inside some quote, and all 103 quotes are verbatim at their stated page (0 mismatches after whitespace collapse).
- **In no quote:**
  - Page 1: "Physical Access", "Deaf or Hard of Hearing Access", "Blind or Low Vision Access", "Cognitive Limitations Access" (white text layer, not visible in render p0000, which shows four pictograms).
  - Page 1: "Strollers for children".
  - 4.1 first sentence (slip-resistant, contrasting strips).
  - 4.7 handrail colour contrast. The `luminance-contrast-and-pattern` slug link's `relevance_note` cites item 4.7 for contrast, yet no observation records it.
  - 8.6 bullets: "large, sliding latch (not thumb-turning)", toilet paper reach, urinal grab bars, call buttons.
  - 9.6 "seats with a variety of widths, adjustable armrests and backrests".
  - 7.3 "Handrails provided at two heights"; 3.6 Sans Serif font; 8.5 automatic faucets; 9.4 accessible counter section.
- **Groups never a surface form:** "persons who are blind", "users who are Deaf or hard of hearing", "those with visual processing difficulties or who are unable to read", "people with low vision". They survive only inside quotes of element phrases.
- **Group provisions classed as elements:** the rationales for 174 (8.2, blind), 198 (11.1, cane) and 182 ("person with limited mobility") class them as "an element or feature … AQ-7", a question about declination.
- **Report:** section 6 prints catalogue-wide tables in which this source contributes MOB and A-EFFORT only. Nothing states that its blind, Deaf, cognitive and quiet-space content reached no row but a DEFERRED observation. ADJUDICATION section 3 item 1 made exactly that point about run 1.

### F8. MEDIUM. R1 passes on a waiver whose reason is not a reason (L8)
- **Artefact:** `search_executions` 204 `findings_note`; `checks-after-engine-v2.txt` line 5.
- **Failure:** R1 reads "0 co1/co2-targeted searches, 0 co1/co2 sources, 1 reasoned waivers". The gate matches the substring `CO1-NOT-APPLICABLE` and nothing else.
- **The reason given** is about the document ("states no co-production"). The same note concedes "A Co-1, T2 or Co-2 pass for the topic was not part of this from-evidence run."
- **Effect:** the batch writes two MOB cells and two harm findings about wheelchair and scooter users with no lived-experience search or source behind them.

### F9. LOW. Parked commands carry a false statement about the wording (L2)
- `2.10-1100` and `6.2-870` notes say 'the source writes "is"'. p0002 prints "Corridors should be 1100mm/43”"; p0005 prints "870mm/34” min clearspace". It is the 850 row's boilerplate (`FLOOR` in `S/helpers/ext_v2.py`). Run as written, each stores that sentence.
- Observation 161 is DEFERRED as "genuinely unsettled", while `6.2-1500` parks the same sentence on parameter 4 and observation 162 (same quote) is NAMES-EXISTING TERM-002.
- "Ten figures parked" is nine figures and one absent finding.

### F10. LOW. Rows bound for canonical point by prose at things that will not exist there (L1)
- Search 204 `findings_note`: "first filed as the first run's GAP-104". In this batch GAP-104 is the `log-mining` gap; the search-subject gap is GAP-103.
- Extraction 231 notes: "extraction 211 in the first scratch database". Canonical already holds extraction 211 (REF-01031, 1.4 m).
- `evidence_population_match` and GAP texts say "in this replay".
- The PDF's manifest line in `L/manifest.jsonl` has `ref_id: null`; only the derived text is keyed to REF-01037. The whole `L` folder is untracked.

### F11. LOW. Bibliographic fields not from the payload (L1)
- `publisher_location='Edmonton, Alberta'`: the string is nowhere in the PDF (`grep -n 'Alberta\|Edmonton' L/1a117aff4c5947a8-full-text.txt` returns four lines, none a place of publication).
- `pub_year=2022` with `pub_year_note` NULL; the basis lives only in GAP-106. That gap calls `cb=1631580961` "an earlier fetch of the same URL", which the payload does not support. It shows only that the URL carried a 2021-09-14 stamp, which bears on whether 2022 is the publication year at all.
- `verification_method='direct-render'` and `lang_detection_method='read on the rendered pages'` were stamped at 22:28 by a run whose own scan note says "the renders were not re-read in this replay".
- **Held:** corporate author, title (printed in capitals), institution, URL, 9 pages, CreationDate 2022-03-24 and Crossref NO-MATCH all agree with the payload.

### F12. LOW. `committee_assertion` basis asserts an origin the source does not state (L3)
- Extractions 229, 230, 231 carry "the committee's own recommendation, not attributed to a code".
- p0000 names "the City of Edmonton's Access Design Guide for best practices"; PDF p. 9 says "Refer to the BARRIER-FREE DESIGN GUIDE for details regarding appropriate dimensions". Both are staged as unread leads (REF-01038, REF-01039).
- Independence of the magenta figures from those guides is unproven. "Not attributed to a code" is supported; "the committee's own" is not.

### F13. LOW. A claimed absence with no probe (L8)
- GAP-104: "a municipal grey PDF has no citation index" is given as the reason the forward pass is deferred. No search was run.
- The source row reads `citation_mining_status='mined'` with `forward=0`.

- **W1.** MOB on extraction 228 (850 mm) rests on a preamble sentence saying wider doors than the minimum are required by many wheelchairs and scooters. The words name the group and the quantity kind, and name this figure's class as inadequate for that group. Whether a sentence disparaging a figure warrants stating that figure for the group is AQ-1 and the adjudicator's own [ASSUMPTION].
- **W2.** Observation 105 adjudicates the "minimum width" of the item 1.2 path to TERM-002, whose scope note makes TERM-048 (circulation route) its element. Whether that places the path before AQ-6 is answered is the owner's.
